aheadSummary: Partly published. The main conference calendar stops at Dec 26, 2026. All six dated Apr-Sep 2027 items come from the youth department's 2026-27 Master Guide and Adventurer calendars (PDF). The weekly Monday Prayer Zoom is counted because the calendar repeats it with no end date. 2027 camp meetings, summer camp, pastors' meetings and the 2026-27 Pathfinder calendar are not published yet.

events.title: Prayer Zoom (weekly, Monday 7 pm)
events.note: Conference-wide prayer meeting, 7-8 pm Central. The calendar sets it to repeat weekly from Mar 30, 2026 with no end date, so it is counted for Apr-Sep 2027; there are no separate 2027 entries.

events.title: Conference Adventurer Bible Game
events.note: Follows the area Adventurer Bible Game in Van Buren (Mar 21, 2027).

events.title: World Adventurer Day
events.note: Listed on the conference Adventurer calendar (May is also investiture month). Kept at the same level as the 2026 Adventurer Day in the v50 file.

events.title: Master Guide "Inspired" workshop (Inspirados GM)
events.note: ARKLAC Master Guides Calendar 2026-2027 (bilingual). July is also recruiting month.

events.title: Master Guide Day (Dia del Guia Mayor)
events.note: Club year starts in August; last day of Master Guide club registration is Aug 31, 2027.

events.title: Club Ministries Leadership Weekend
events.place: Camp Yorktown Bay, Mountain Pine, AR
events.audience: Adventurer, Pathfinder and Master Guide leaders
events.note: Master Guide calendar: "Leadership Weekend / Semana de Liderazgo CYB". Same weekend slot as Sep 11-13, 2026. September-October is club induction month.

notes: Main calendar (Events Calendar widget on arklac.org/calendar, public data feed, 266 entries) ends on Dec 26, 2026. Its only open-ended item is the weekly Monday Prayer Zoom. The Wix Events list on the site (19 events) ends Nov 7-8, 2026 (Blended Families).
All other Apr-Sep 2027 items come from the youth department PDFs: ARKLAC Master Guides Calendar 2026-2027 (runs to Dec 2027 holidays) and ARKLA Adventurer Calendar 2026-2027 (ends May 2027).

Not counted (months or deadlines, not events): Adventurer and Master Guide investiture month (May 2027), Master Guide recruiting month (Jul 2027), club start (Aug 2027), Master Guide registration deadline (Aug 31, 2027), induction month (Sep-Oct 2027).
The Pathfinder page labels its calendar 2026-2027, but the link still opens the 2025-2026 Pathfinder calendar. Spring 2027 Pathfinder camporee, PBE and honors dates are therefore not published yet.

Not published yet for 2027: South Louisiana and NW Arkansas camp meetings, Spanish campestres, Camp Yorktown Bay summer camp (dates page shows 2026), pastors' and area ministers' meetings, Bible worker school. The NAD camp-meeting list shows 2026 only.
Record (union magazine): no Apr-Sep 2027 dates in the 2026 Arkansas-Louisiana stories online or in the Sep/Oct 2026 print issue. One church team says it is preparing for PBE 2027 (no date).
NW Arkansas church events page runs only to Jan 23, 2027 (church level).
